description: This file defines the interface 'FieldExpressionFactory', which serves as a factory for creating different types of FieldExpression objects such as filter, exists, and sort expressions based on property names. It provides method signatures for retrieving these expressions and documents potential exceptions if property names are invalid.

classes.name: FieldExpressionFactory
classes.description: An interface defining factory methods for obtaining field expressions such as filtering, existence check, and sorting based on property names.

methods.name: filterBy
methods.description: Retrieves a FilterFieldExpression for filtering based on the specified property name.

methods.name: existsBy
methods.description: Retrieves an ExistsFieldExpression to check for the existence of a property.

methods.name: sortBy
methods.description: Retrieves a SortFieldExpression for sorting based on the given property name.
